# WeyBay [italic]Buy it on the relay. Pick it up in Logistics. Things, delivered, eventually.[/italic]
Put your ID card in the reader, pick something, press BUY. It comes off your account straight away and in on the next freight run, in a crate with your name on it, on the pickup pallet. We mail you when it lands.
[color=#6A6A6A]WeyBay is not affiliated with Weyland-Yutani, whatever the name suggests, and has been asked twice. Crates are the property of whoever opens them first, legally speaking, so please collect promptly.[/color]
